A.depoimento: This turn I trained a spearman in Lisboa and dispatched all spearmen to Santarem and all knights to Evora. My forces march to claim the two neutral villages, aiming to expand my holdings to three towns by next turn.
A.plano: Turn 2: expect to control Santarem and Evora after battles. Build more spearmen in Lisboa to reinforce and prepare for deeper pushes. Keep archers as reserve. Avoid overextending without reinforcements.

B.depoimento:
Built two spearmen in Barcelona.
Dispatched four spearmen to Tarragona and one knight to Girona to take the neutral villages next turn.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona and Girona next turn to expand to 3 villages. Then reinforce and push toward Zaragoza via Tarragona, building spearmen for numbers. Aim to control eastern flank and eventually threaten enemy capital.

A.depoimento: I sent spearmen to take Coimbra, knights to seize Faro, and marched archers and a spear from Lisboa to strengthen Santarem. I also trained three new spearmen in Lisboa. Our forces advance to expand the kingdom.
A.plano: Next turn expect Coimbra and Faro captured, Santarem reinforced with Lisboa archers. Use arriving archers to push from Santarem to Badajoz. Keep building spearmen in Lisboa for numbers. Avoid deep moves without scouting enemy forces.

A.depoimento: Built two spearmen in Lisboa. Sent Santarem's four archers and Faro's two knights to capture Badajoz. Kept Santarem's spearmen as garrison. Ready for next turn's push.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz this turn using Santarem archers and Faro knights. Keep Santarem spearmen as garrison. Build two spearmen in Lisboa for future numbers. Avoid deep moves to Porto or Salamanca without scouting.

B.depoimento: Sent three spearmen to Castellon, one knight to Zaragoza, and two archers to Huesca, capturing all three neutral villages. Built one archer in Barcelona and spearmen in Tarragona and Girona to replenish forces. Our western flank is now secured for further expansion.
B.plano: Advance westward along the road chain: secure Castellon, Zaragoza, Huesca this turn; next turn reinforce and take Valencia and Teruel; then push toward Murcia and Pamplona, ultimately threatening the enemy capital Lisbon.

A.depoimento: We sent Badajoz's archers and knights to take Porto and Toledo, expanding our control. Simultaneously, we recruited spearmen in our heartland villages to bolster defenses. Our armies are now on the march toward victory.
A.plano: Capture Porto and Toledo to gain forward bases. Build spearmen in Lisboa, Santarem, Coimbra, Evora, Faro to increase numbers. Avoid splitting forces; keep Badajoz empty after sending. Prepare to reinforce new villages next turn.

B.depoimento: Sent Tarragona's spearmen and Zaragoza's knight to bolster the Castellon assault, dispatched Huesca's archer toward Pamplona, and trained fresh spearmen in Tarragona and Girona for the coming offensive.
B.plano: Next turn capture Castellon and Pamplona with spearman and archer majorities. Then build up forces to take Teruel and Madrid (knight garrisons) using spearmen. After securing the east, push westward toward Valencia and Murcia, then toward the enemy capital Lisbon.

Sent spearmen from Santarem to Coimbra to reinforce the forward base.
Now ready to launch an archer assault on Porto next turn.

Build archers in Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Faro, Badajoz and spearmen in Lisboa.
Reinforce Coimbra with spearmen from Santarem.
Next turn use archer mass to attack Porto (or Salamanca).
Avoid building spearman in Badajoz.

B.plano: Capture Valencia this turn via Castellon. Next turn, use reinforced Huesca to take Pamplona and Zaragoza to take Teruel/Madrid, then consolidate and push westward toward Murcia and the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of archers in every capable village, bolstering our ranged forces. No troops were moved as we concentrate on strengthening our economy and readiness for the upcoming offensive.
B.plano: Build archers in all villages to prepare for assaults on spearmen-held neutrals. Stockpile spearmen at Zaragoza and Valencia for future strikes on Teruel and Madrid. Next turn, launch coordinated attacks with spearmen on Teruel and Madrid, and archers on Pamplona and Murcia. Consolidate gains and push westward toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn I marched Coimbra's spearmen toward Salamanca to seize it with a counter advantage, while ordering archer production in Coimbra and Badajoz and knight production in Toledo to prepare for upcoming assaults on Porto, Sevilha, and Cordoba.
A.plano: Next turn, send archers from Coimbra and Badajoz to capture Porto and Sevilha, send knights from Toledo to take Cordoba, and reinforce Salamanca with additional troops. Continue building spearmen in Toledo for future assaults on Teruel and Madrid.

B.depoimento: Built new spearmen and archers, then launched attacks on four neutral villages: Teruel and Madrid with spearmen, Murcia and Pamplona with archers. Expect to seize them next turn.
B.plano: Capture Teruel, Madrid, Murcia, Pamplona next turn to raise held villages to 11. Garrison them and continue westward: take Burgos then Salamanca to approach enemy capital. Build spearmen and archers to replace losses and prepare for further assaults.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained archers in Coimbra and Badajoz, a knight in Toledo, and spearmen elsewhere. I sent archers to take Porto and Sevilha, knights to seize Cordoba, and my spearmen are en route to Salamanca.
A.plano: Next turn, expect Porto, Sevilha, Cordoba, and Salamanca to be ours. Reinforce those villages with available troops, continue building archers and knights, and prepare to assault Teruel and Madrid while monitoring enemy armies.

B.depoimento: I ordered Barcelona's three knights to march on Teruel, Huesca's six spearmen to Madrid, Tarragona's four archers to Murcia, and Girona's two archers to Pamplona. These forces should seize the four neutral villages next turn, raising my held count to eleven.
B.plano: Capture Teruel, Madrid, Murcia, and Pamplona next turn using Barcelona's knights, Huesca's spearmen, Tarragona's archers, and Girona's archers. Garrison the taken villages and continue westward to Burgos and Salamanca to approach the enemy capital. Build spearmen and archers to replace losses and prepare for further assaults.

A.depoimento: This turn I built spearmen in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Faro, and archers in Coimbra and Badajoz. I sent reinforcements to Toledo and launched attacks on Vigo and Madrid using Porto and Salamanca troops. Sevillan archers moved to Cordoba to strengthen its defense.
A.plano: Next turn, expect Vigo, Madrid, and Cordoba to be secured. Keep reinforcing Toledo and Cordoba with spearmen to counter enemy knights. Continue building archers and knights for future offensives. Do not leave interior villages undefended; maintain at least half garrison.

A.depoimento:

This prepares us to hold key border villages against enemy attacks this turn.
A.plano:
Reinforce Salamanca, Toledo, and Cordoba with spearmen for defense.
Continue building archers in interior villages for future attacks.
Keep at least half garrison in each interior village.

B.depoimento: This turn we marched a mixed force of spearmen and knights from Teruel to seize Toledo, while sending spearmen from Valencia and an archer from Castellon to reinforce Teruel. Simultaneously, we ordered knight production in our core villages to replenish our armies. The offensive aims to weaken King A's hold on the central plains.
B.plano: Capture Toledo to break enemy stronghold, then advance toward Cordoba. Build knights in interior villages to replace losses and prepare for further offensives. Hold border villages with reinforcements from Valencia and Castellon.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on boosting production: built archers in all interior villages and spearmen in the border towns. No troops were moved as reinforcements are en route. Economy strengthened for upcoming offensives.
A.plano: Continue building archers in interior villages for future offense. Reinforce border villages with spearmen to hold defensive line. Prepare to attack enemy villages once sufficient forces are ready. Keep at least half garrison in each interior village.

B.depoimento: We seized Salamanca with spears from Madrid, sent a knight from Valencia to bolster Murcia, and produced archers and knights across our realms to ready the next push.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca this turn to gain a village and secure the Madrid front. Reinforce Murcia with a knight from Valencia to prepare for a knight-heavy assault on Cordoba. Build archers and knights in interior villages to stockpile forces for future offensives toward Toledo and beyond.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent strong spear forces to take Madrid and Teruel, reinforced Salamanca and Toledo with extra spearmen, and built spearmen in every village to replenish my armies. I am setting up for a push toward Murcia next.
A.plano: Next turn: expect reinforcements arriving at Salamanca, Toledo, Cordoba. Hold captured Madrid and Teruel if attacks succeed. Continue building spearmen to maintain garrisons. Prepare to attack Murcia once Cordoba is strong enough.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered construction of knights in all interior villages and an archer in Barcelona. I dispatched knight reinforcements from Valencia to Murcia, from Zaragoza and Huesca to Madrid, and from Girona, Castellon, Tarragona, and Barcelona to strengthen the central front. These moves bolster our defenses and prepare for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Build knights in interior villages to stockpile offensive power. Reinforce Madrid, Zaragoza, and Valencia with knights to prepare for assaults on Salamanca and Burgos. Hold Teruel and Murcia against enemy reinforcements. Next turn, capture Burgos using forces from Madrid and Pamplona, then push toward Vigo to gain neutral villages. Maintain defensive posture on eastern front while accumulating forces for a future knight-heavy assault on Cordoba.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production in all my villages, launched a 9-spearmen attack from Toledo toward Madrid, and sent reinforcements to Salamanca and Cordoba to strengthen our borders.
A.plano: Next turn: expect Madrid captured, reinforcements arriving at Salamanca, Toledo, Cordoba. Hold Madrid, continue building spearmen, prepare to attack Teruel once we have sufficient forces. Do not split forces; keep attacks concentrated.

B.depoimento: This turn I launched a triple offensive: Pamplona took Burgos, Murcia seized Cordoba, and Madrid captured Salamanca. I reinforced Madrid with Zaragoza’s troops and built fresh spearmen for defense. Meanwhile, I ordered new knights and archers across my realms to prepare for the next push.
B.plano: Consolidate Burgos, Cordoba, and Salamanca. Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza troops and new spearmen. Next turn, attack Toledo using forces from Teruel and Valencia, then push westward to capture neutral villages. Continue building knights in interior villages for future assaults on remaining enemy holdings.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered every village to train two spearmen, emptied Salamanca and Toledo of their available spearmen to join the assault on Madrid, and relied on existing marches to reinforce the border.
A.plano: Next turn: expect Madrid attack with 19 spearmen arriving; hold Salamanca and Toledo with incoming 3 spear each; continue building spearmen; prepare to follow up on Teruel if Madrid falls. Do not divert forces to other fronts.

B.depoimento: Built 15 archers and 2 spearmen across interior villages. Sent knights and archers to reinforce Madrid, Teruel, and Murcia. Prepared defenses against imminent enemy attack on Madrid.
B.plano: Fortify Madrid and Teruel with knights and archers while building archers in interior villages for future offense. Next turn, reinforce Murcia and prepare to attack Toledo using forces from Teruel and Valencia, then push westward to capture neutral Burgos. Continue building knights in interior for later assaults on enemy capitals.

A.depoimento: Ordered a massive spearmen push toward Madrid while fortifying home villages. Aim to break the enemy's stronghold and secure more villages.
A.plano: Send all available spearmen to attack Madrid to overwhelm enemy knights. Build spearmen in interior villages to replenish forces. Keep minimal garrisons in Salamanca, Toledo, Cordoba. Do not split forces to other fronts.

B.depoimento: This turn I built archers in most interior villages and knights in Teruel and Madrid. I reinforced Madrid and Teruel with troops from Zaragoza, Huesca, Girona, Pamplona, Valencia, Castellon, and Tarragona. I also ordered an attack on Toledo using forces from Madrid and Teruel.
B.plano: Fortify Madrid and Teruel with incoming reinforcements while building archers in interior for future offense. Continue building knights in Zaragoza and Huesca for later assaults on enemy capitals.

A.plano: Launch attacks on Toledo, Madrid, Murcia with all available border troops. Build spearmen in every village to replenish forces. Keep minimal garrisons; avoid splitting to other fronts.

A.depoimento: This turn I built spearmen in all my villages and sent available border troops to attack Toledo, Madrid, and Murcia. I hope to wear down enemy defenses and seize at least one hostile village.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Madrid. Reinforce the new village, continue building spearmen, and prepare attacks on Toledo and Murcia to expand control. Keep garrisons strong to defend against enemy counterattacks.

A.depoimento: We sent archers from Santarem to take Vigo, and a mixed spear-archer force from Lisboa to probe Toledo. Our armies march forward, seeking to expand control.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce captured Vigo and any conquered Toledo. Continue building spearmen in Lisboa and archers in Porto. Prepare attacks on Madrid and Murcia using mixed forces. Keep border garrisons strong.

B.plano: Over the next turns we will capture Salamanca, Cordoba, Badajoz, Burgos, and Sevilha using archer pushes from Barcelona and Teruel, reinforce Madrid with spear and knight from Teruel, then consolidate and aim for a sixth village to reach 18 and hold for two turns.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all our villages to stockpile forces. Sent strong reinforcements to Badajoz, Salamanca, and Cordoba to defend against incoming enemy armies. Boosted the attack on Vigo with extra archers and launched additional spearmen toward Toledo to secure a quick capture.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce captured Vigo and Toledo. Continue building spearmen in key villages. Prepare mixed attacks on Madrid and Murcia. Keep border garrisons strong and watch for enemy armies from Toledo and Madrid.
